title: Vintage Gibson SG Value Guide: Four Models And Eras
description: Compare vintage Gibson SG value across Standard, Special, Junior and Custom models. Joe explains condition, originality and how to assess an offer.
alt: Cherry Gibson SG Standard with two covered humbuckers, a small pickguard and sideways vibrato

faqs.q: How Much Is A Vintage Gibson SG Worth?
faqs.a: Vintage Gibson SG comparisons range from $6,000 to $11,000 for original cherry 1961 to 1965 Specials, while clean original cherry 1965 Standards sit around $12,000 to $14,000 as of October 2026. I use separate ranges for Juniors and Customs because their condition, pickups and production periods differ.

faqs.q: Are All SG Price Ranges For The Same Condition?
faqs.a: They aren't. The Standard and Special rows cover original guitars with the stated wear allowance. The Junior and Custom rows allow disclosed parts or wiring changes. Match the full condition description before applying any row to your guitar.

faqs.q: Is A Dealer Offer The Same As The Published Range?
faqs.a: It isn't. The table describes completed-sale comparisons before shipping and tax. A buying offer also accounts for the instrument's condition, selling costs, preparation and the dealer's margin. I explain an offer for the actual guitar rather than promising the top of a general range.

faqs.q: Does A Quality Refret Change The Collector Category?
faqs.a: A quality refret is accepted maintenance and preserves the all-original classification of an otherwise all-original guitar. It takes the instrument out of the museum-quality category. Neck reshaping is a separate alteration.
